name: trend
question: Show the monthly sales trend.
sql: SELECT month_start, SUM(sales_amount) AS sales_amount FROM sales_channel_monthly GROUP BY month_start

name: comparison
question: Compare sales by channel.
sql: SELECT channel, SUM(sales_amount) AS sales_amount FROM sales_channel_monthly GROUP BY channel

name: ranking
question: Rank channels by sales.
sql: SELECT channel, SUM(sales_amount) AS sales_amount FROM sales_channel_monthly GROUP BY channel ORDER BY sales_amount DESC

name: composition
question: Show the sales composition by channel.
sql: SELECT channel, SUM(sales_amount) AS sales_amount FROM sales_channel_monthly GROUP BY channel

name: schema_repair
question: Show sales after correcting an unknown field.
sql: SELECT channel, SUM(sales_amount) AS sales_amount FROM sales_channel_monthly GROUP BY channel
